title: Code, results and protocol for 'The Per-Shock Price of Own Feedback in Online Conformal Value-at-Risk: Lower Bounds, Exact Per-Day Optima and Known-Law Attainment'
description: Simulation and analysis code, JSON results, the supplement (full proofs and results) and the frozen, hashed confirmatory protocol with three amendments for the paper. The empirical study is exploratory; the confirmatory test has not been run. Raw vendor data are not redistributed; download scripts and SHA-256 checksums are included.
notes: Code (code/) is MIT-licensed; the supplement, results, figures and protocol documents are licensed under CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE and LICENSE-CC-BY-4.0).
